subject: LOWER-CASE function
notes: kb/Work PB64 T5 (2026-08-19) — was PARTIAL (the locale clause absent). Both clauses hold by the same property: TextInfo.ToLower / ToLowerInvariant are TOTAL maps, the identity on every code point without a simple lowercase mapping, so an uppercase letter with no correspondent — under the implementor's map or in a locale whose LC_CTYPE gives none — is returned unchanged, character for character (the unit test's de-DE / invariant arms; the goldens' non-letter and untailored letters).
